## Data, privacy, and security

- [ ] I did not include real databases, backups, recovery snapshots, rosters,
      student records, browser profiles, sensitive screenshots, `.env` files,
      credentials, or logs containing personal data.
- [ ] All examples, fixtures, screenshots, and demonstrations use manually
      created synthetic data such as `Siswa Contoh 01`, `DEMO-0001`, and
      `Kelas Demo A`.
- [ ] I did not derive fixtures by partially masking or hashing production data.
- [ ] I reviewed changes to browser storage, backups, imports/exports, external
      requests, and permissions, or they are not applicable.

## Compatibility and rollback

- [ ] I documented database migration, backup compatibility, and rollback
      implications, or they are not applicable.
- [ ] The change preserves local-first/offline behavior, or the accepted design
      explicitly explains why it changes.

## Quality

- [ ] I added or updated tests proportional to the risk.
- [ ] I added both Indonesian and English strings for user-facing text.
- [ ] I updated user, privacy, deployment, or contributor documentation where
      behavior changed.
- [ ] Relevant local checks pass.
